subject: add greek letters to the linetype argument

messages.author: db38d16a2a6b8dc7
messages.subject: add greek letters to the linetype argument
parts:
Hey Guys,

I would like to add Greek letters to the linetype argument.  Here is a simple example:

data <- data.frame(x=1:10,y=1:10,z=11:20)
plot <- ggplot(data,aes(x=x)) + geom_line(aes(y=y,linetype="Greek letters here")) +
    geom_line(aes(y=z,linetype="Greek letters here also"))
plot

I need to be able to mix Greek letters with normal text inside the linetype argument. 

Thanks for the help,

Chandler

messages.author: 0c722f02bfd81abd
messages.subject: Re: add greek letters to the linetype argument
parts:
Hi Hadley,

Let me clarify further.  When I specify the linetype, the text in the linetype goes into the legend.  So, if I have 

plot + geom_line(aes(y=line1,linetype="line1")) + geom_line(aes(y=line2,linetype="line2"))

then "line1" and "line2" will show up in legend describing the two lines.  I need to add Greek letters to the descriptions in the legend of line1 and line2.

I hope this is more clear,

Chandler

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: add greek letters to the linetype argument
parts:
Hi

try this:

data2 <- melt(data, id = "x")
ggplot(data2, aes(x, value, linetype = variable)) + geom_line() +
scale_linetype("title of legend", breaks = c("y", "z"), labels =
list(expression(alpha), expression(beta)))
